class.name: IfcLagTime
class.brief_description: IfcLagTime describes the time parameters that may exist within a sequence relationship between two processes. HISTORY: New entity in IFC Release 2x4. Use Definitions An IfcLagTime provides information about the time lag that exists between the predecessor and successor process in a sequence. members.member: Value of the time lag selected as being either a ratio or a time measure. A value (String, float, int or bool), or null when unset. Only in IFC4 and IFC4X3_ADD2 files: in others it reads as null and can't be set.

The allowed types of task duration that specify the lag time measurement (work time or elapsed time). A String, one of the enumeration's values, or null when unset. Only in IFC4 and IFC4X3_ADD2 files: in others it reads as null and can't be set.
